title: Koriun investors returned to the government complex on Aug26 after July31 action
description: La Prensa explicitly connects the Aug26 Congress gathering to the July31 Casa Presidencial action by shared Koriun group and same repayment/answers objective. This does not establish uninterrupted attendance between dates.

title: Mateo road-repair protest sequence continued in August
description: Aug13 body says repeated protests and cites an earlier May21 promise; Aug28 search result reports another executed road blockade. Exact first protest date and separate-day headcounts remain unresolved.
